# Omarchy Kit

> A bilingual (English / Spanish) learning portal and set of reversible setup scripts for running Omarchy (Arch Linux + Hyprland) on one specific laptop: the 15" MacBook Pro, mid-2014 (MacBookPro11,3). It teaches Omarchy with the machine's own live shortcuts, checks that lessons were really done, and carries the fixes that make this old Mac quiet, cool and usable: working sleep and hibernate, the NVIDIA GPU switched off, a battery power lab, Mac-style keys and accents, a speaker EQ and six original themes. Python standard library only, no build tools; it serves only on 127.0.0.1. Every change to the machine has an installer with --remove and a record on the app's Setup log.

Rules for any assistant working in this repository: read AGENTS.md first; never run an installer or probe a script with --help without reading its argument handling; you cannot use sudo, give the owner the exact command; every user-visible string needs English and Spanish; do not push or publish without the owner's word. The repository is public, so documents never contain personal details or private project names.

Source: https://github.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit. Code is MIT; the themes' palettes, files, previews, wallpapers and texts are CC BY 4.0. The complete documentation in a single file is llms-full.txt.

## How it works

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the build chain, the server and its security model, the browser code, the lesson engine, the Setup log, where state lives
- [Developing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/DEVELOPING.md): setup, the edit loop, conventions, and recipes for adding a lesson, habit, Setup row, installer, theme or document
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/GLOSSARY.md): one definition per term used across the documentation
- [Field notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/FIELD-NOTES.md): short, checkable rules learned the hard way on this machine

## Hardware topics

- [Sleep, the lid and hibernate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/SLEEP.md): why deep sleep never wakes on lid-open here, what was installed instead, measurements, trade-offs, the open decision
- [Power lab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/POWER-LAB.md): where the roughly 20 W of an idle MacBook goes, what was tried and ruled out, how to use the tool
- [sleep/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/sleep/README.md): light sleep, hibernate that stays off, one password after hibernate, the battery log, sleep-check
- [power/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/power/README.md): the power profile follows the charger, Wi-Fi power saving, power-lab, msr-probe
- [gpu/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/gpu/README.md): keep the hot NVIDIA GPU off, firmware boot GPU
- [audio/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/audio/README.md): the speaker EQ that bypasses itself for headphones
- [boot/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/boot/README.md): a faster, themed boot screen
- [backup/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/backup/README.md): hourly /home snapshots and Pika Backup

## Feeling like a Mac

- [Mac feel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/MAC-FEEL.md): accents, command-key shortcuts, gestures, the top row, power profile, what was verified and how to undo it
- [keys/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/keys/README.md): Mac command-key shortcuts inside apps and the opt-in extras
- [trackpad/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/trackpad/README.md): three-finger swipe or drag
- [appearance/ scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/appearance/README.md): light by day, dark at night

## Themes

- [Themes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/omarchy-kit/main/docs/THEMES.md): the six original themes, their inspiration chain, how to try them, licence and decisions
